spectra: G (decision_ready -> ((act_auto | defer_human | halt) & !(act_auto & defer_human) & !(act_auto & halt) & !(defer_human & halt)))
rules.note: When decision is ready, exactly one action is chosen; otherwise, no action is taken.
Anomalies prevent automatic action in the same step.
Override requests prevent automatic action in the same step.
Deferring to a human requires a human to be available.
When a decision is ready, the system acts automatically if there is no anomaly and no override.
